name: Mist Resonance Harmonize needs the Class Bonus: a non-Tamer champion's allies still assign damage with power
notes: A Melody was activated but the champion is not a Tamer, so the [Class Bonus] Harmonize clause does not apply: the Dungeon Guide assigns 1 damage.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Harmonize -- If you've activated a Melody card this turn, allies you control assign damage with their life stat instead of power stat until end of turn.
